hook.say: True or false? Five facts about lakes, seas and waterfalls. Three seconds each. Don't trust the names!

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.q: The Dead Sea is actually a lake.
questions.fact: It is a landlocked salt lake between Jordan and Israel.
questions.sayAnswer: True! Despite the name, it is a landlocked salt lake.

questions.fact: The 979 m waterfall is in Venezuela.
questions.sayAnswer: False! The 979 meter waterfall is in Venezuela.

questions.q: Niagara Falls is the tallest waterfall in North America.
questions.fact: Niagara drops about 57 m. Yosemite Falls drops 739 m.
questions.sayAnswer: False! Niagara drops about 57 meters. Yosemite Falls drops 739.

questions.q: Lake Baikal holds about a fifth of Earth's fresh surface water.
questions.fact: Baikal in Siberia holds more water than all the Great Lakes combined.
questions.sayAnswer: True! One Siberian lake holds more water than all 5 Great Lakes combined.

questions.q: The Sargasso Sea has no coastline at all.
questions.fact: It is the only sea bounded by ocean currents instead of land.
questions.sayAnswer: True! It is the only sea bordered by ocean currents instead of land.
